authority: Latest direct user request and explicit static-constructor choice supersede the earlier passive-store attachment.

ownership.facts: Static constructor populates defaults and applies known environment overrides once; fifteen getter-only static properties.
ownership.policy: EnvironmentKind, CommitId and BuildId are ordinary application-populated properties; supply before consumers start.
ownership.logging: Getter-only Logging reference contains mutable options. LoggingOptions.Prepare validates module settings/paths; logging owns runtime startup.

precedence: Discovered/literal defaults < nonblank existing alias < nonblank canonical variable. Selected invalid overrides fail; shadowed aliases are not read.
defaults: Entry assembly name; informational version then assembly version then unknown; service version falls back to actual build; environment unknown; current host/runtime/process; new UUID; UTC population instant.
failure: CLR wraps static-constructor invalid selected overrides or invalid discovered identity/build metadata in TypeInitializationException, permanently failing this type in the load context. Correct configuration or application assembly metadata and restart; no reset/retry API.
metadata: Logging constructs EventMetadata(); it copies allowlisted facts without retaining settings. Internal controlled-fact fixtures do not imply writable runtime properties.
compatibility: No published releases; earlier candidates and execution evidence are historical. The logging roadmap remains paused.
